blocks.text: Overview: Tension type headache (TTH) is the most common primary headache disorder, usually mild-to-moderate and self- limited
Bilateral pressing, tightening non pulsating pain, Photophobia or phonophobia may occur
Clinical, CT/MRI once there are red flags Neurological deficits, papilloedema on fundoscopy
Prevention: For frequent or chronic TTH >15days per month

Migraine is a primary headache characterized by moderate to severe, often unilateral, throbbing pain, aggravated by movement associated with nausea, photo/phonophobia, aura-visual or sensory symptoms before headache.
